description: Sound library for the Feather ESP32-C3 gadget (MuseSDK). All clips are mono 22050 Hz.
name: feather-sounds

cat.description: Two synthesized meows followed by a purr.

first-words.description: Eli's first spoken words through the Feather.

goose.description: Three synthesized goose honks. Terrifying, by design.

fanfare.description: A triumphant synthesized trumpet fanfare — the classic 'Charge!' bugle call with a big held finish.

closing-bell.description: Five strikes of a synthesized closing bell with long ring.

bell-chime.description: A single synthesized bell chime with a long ring.

applause.description: Three seconds of applause with cheering.
